title: What came between Later Liang dynasty and Later Jin dynasty?
question: What came between Later Liang dynasty and Later Jin dynasty?
claim: 3 documented links lead from Later Liang dynasty (907) to Later Jin dynasty (936): 0 of cause and effect, 3 of succession.
why: Each record is joined to the one before it by a Wikidata statement (has effect, has cause, followed by, follows, replaced by, replaces), and the dates run forward. The longest such chain from the first record was taken, preferring cause and effect.
